description.zh: 指定询价的实例 ID，升级场景必须设置，用于获取实例升级前配置。
description.en: The ID of the instance for which the price is queried. This parameter is required if you upgrade an instance. You can specify this parameter to obtain the pre-upgrade configurations of the instance.
The information about the pricing module.

description.zh:
订单类型。取值范围：
- NewOrder：新购。
- Renewal：续费。
- Upgrade：升级。
description.en:
The type of the order. Valid values:

*   NewOrder: purchases an instance of an Alibaba Cloud service.
*   Renewal: renews an instance of an Alibaba Cloud service.
*   Upgrade: upgrades an instance of an Alibaba Cloud service.
The code of the service. For more information about the service code, see **Codes of Alibaba Cloud Services**.

description.zh: 产品类型，是否必输以具体产品的询价文档为准。
description.en: The type of the service. Specify the parameter based on the pricing document of the specific service.
The ID of the region in which the instance resides.

description.zh:
服务时长单位。取值范围：
- Year：年。
- Month：月。
description.en:
The unit of the service duration. Valid values:

*   Year
*   Month

description.zh: 订阅类型。取值类型：Subscription（预付费）。
description.en: The billing method. Set the value to Subscription.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi get-subscription-price --service-period-unit Year --subscription-type Subscription --product-code ecs --order-type NewOrder --service-period-quantity 1 --product-type ecs --biz-region cn-hangzhou --instance-id i-khkjhxxxxxxxxx --quantity 1 --module-list ModuleCode=PackageCode Config=PackageCode:version_1 ModuleStatus=1 Tag=213213123 --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun bssopenapi GetSubscriptionPrice --region cn-hangzhou --ProductCode ecs --InstanceId 'i-khkjhxxxxxxxxx' --ModuleList.1.Config 'PackageCode:version_1' --ProductType ecs --Quantity 1 --ModuleList.1.Tag 213213123 --ServicePeriodUnit Year --SubscriptionType Subscription --OrderType NewOrder --ServicePeriodQuantity 1 --ModuleList.1.ModuleCode PackageCode --ModuleList.1.ModuleStatus 1 --Region 'cn-hangzhou'
